_help: Settings for the studiio.co client system (admin → Pipeline). Change a value here and the admin uses it straight away. Mario confirmed the onboarding spec's defaults on 2026-11-25; keys still listed under "unconfirmed" have no value yet (budget_ranges: the intake form skips the budget question until it has ranges). Keep it valid JSON (double quotes, no trailing commas) and check it with: php admin/tools/check-crm.php documents.invoice_due_days: 0 means an invoice is due on receipt. Bank details for invoices are not kept here (this file is public on GitHub): type them on the admin Payments page, which stores them privately on the server.
